|os = {{Name|Fishing Treasure Chest}}{{Name|Artifact Trove|3.6%}} |sellprice = 60 }} The '''Ancient Doll''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[The Mountain]], [[Cindersap Forest]], [[Bus Stop]], or [[Pelican Town]], and inside [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] and [[Artifact Trove]]s. It can also be received as a gift from [[Jas]], [[Leo]], or [[Vincent]] at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It is sold by Jas at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|1|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]. ==Donation== Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Jas |like=Dwarf,Penny |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Ancient Doll is an option in the {{Bundle|Childrens||y}}. ==Tailoring== Ancient Doll is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Doll Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt229.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Ancient Doll is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Secrets== * The Ancient Doll is a recurring part of the [[Secrets#Dove Children|dove children secrets]]. * The Ancient Doll can be used to obtain a [[Far Away Stone|secret item]] by throwing it (right-clicking) into the lava pool on floor 100 of [[the Mines]] or in the [[Forge|Volcano Caldera]]. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source.
